The '''Chandrila Defense Fleet''' was the [[Navy/Legends|Defense Fleet]] of the planet [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].

{{Military-stub}}

==History==
[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Hiram Drayson/Legends|Hiram Drayson]] led the [[Fleet/Legends|Fleet]] for many years during the last decades of the Republic,<ref name="DFRS" /><ref name="TLCS" /> until he was replaced by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] military council with [[Kohl Seerdon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Insider" /> It was requisitioned by the emerging [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and merged into the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] under his command. After the fall of the Empire, Drayson was reassigned to lead the Fleet again.
